What If You Could Forget Every Painful Memory—But Lose Your Humanity?

In The Haunted Man and the Ghost’s Bargain, Charles Dickens weaves a spellbinding tale of sorrow, redemption, and the price of forgetting. Chemistry professor Redlaw is haunted by painful memories when a mysterious ghost offers him an extraordinary gift: the chance to erase his suffering. At first, it feels like liberation—but as the shadows of his past disappear, so too does his compassion, unravelling his relationships and leaving the world around him cold and unfeeling.

Can Redlaw restore what truly matters before it’s too late?
Blending Dickens’ signature wit, warmth, and supernatural intrigue, this unforgettable novella explores the purpose of pain and the profound beauty of memory.
